title: Decision-Focused Evaluation of Worst-Case Distribution Shift
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its focus is on decision-focused evaluation of worst-case distribution shifts in resource allocation settings, using demographic data such as race, education, and income from US census data.
